retailers: Online at Amazon.com from August 2023 through February 2026 for about $55.

cpsc-26392.title: Magnetic Drinkware Charms Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Magnets; Sold on Amazon by Maitys
cpsc-26392.reason: The recalled magnetic drinkware charms violate the mandatory standard for magnets because they contain loose magnets posing an ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other, or other metal objects, and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death.
cpsc-26392.company: Hefei Maitusilu Wangluokeji Youxiangongsi, dba Maitys, of China
